the busy theme park main street

Soft pretzels dipped in a bicarb bath, baked chewy and brown, brushed with butter and rolled in cinnamon sugar, with warm caramel dip. Mix 500g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tsp salt, 1 tbsp sugar and 320ml warm water into a dough, knead 8 minutes and rest 1 hour. Shape into 8 pretzels. Boil 2L water with 4 tbsp bicarb soda and dip each pretzel for 30 seconds. Bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Brush with 60g melted butter and toss in 100g sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon. Serve with warmed caramel sauce.
M: Owen at his bungalow by the lake

Beef short ribs rubbed with paprika and pepper, slow cooked until they pull off the bone, glazed sticky, with buttered corn and slaw. Rub 2kg beef short ribs with 2 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tbsp cracked pepper, 1 tbsp brown sugar and 2 tsp salt. Wrap tightly in foil and cook at 140C for 5 hours. Unwrap, brush with 200ml barbecue sauce and roast at 220C for 15 minutes until sticky. Boil 4 corn cobs for 6 minutes and butter them. Toss half a shredded cabbage and 1 grated carrot with 4 tbsp mayo and 1 tbsp vinegar.

dishes.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 hour, grill fresh

ingredients.item: limes, one zested and the rest in wedges

steps.text: Toss the prawns with the garlic, chilli, lime zest and melted butter.
Grill for 2 minutes a side until charred.
Pile high on a platter with lime wedges.
Mix the cheddar, cream cheese and chives. Roll into small balls.
Coat in the walnuts mixed with the paprika.
Chill for an hour until firm. Serve with water crackers.

dishes.make_ahead: Salsa up to 2 hours ahead, fish fresh

steps.text: Dice the pineapple and onion and mix with lime juice for the salsa. Mix the sour cream with lime for the crema.
Dust the fish in the chilli, cumin and salt and pan-fry until just cooked. Flake into pieces.
Warm the tortillas and shred the cabbage.
Fill the tortillas with cabbage, fish, salsa and crema.

dishes.make_ahead: Make a day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Melt the chocolate and cool slightly.
Whip the cream and whisk the egg whites to soft peaks. Stir the yolks into the chocolate, then fold in the cream and whites.
Spoon into glasses and chill for 2 hours.
Top with crushed biscuits and a speckled chocolate egg.

dishes.make_ahead: Freeze a day ahead, blitz fresh

steps.text: Dissolve the sugar in the lemon juice and water.
Freeze in a tray for 2 hours.
Blitz with a few handfuls of ice until slushy and pour into big cups with straws.

s.note: Garlic chili lime butter shrimp grilled and piled on a platter
s.how: Toss 600g green prawns with crushed garlic, chopped red chilli, lime zest and melted butter. Grill for 2 minutes a side until charred. Pile high on a platter with lime wedges, ready for the crowd at feeding time.

s.note: Cheddar and cream cheese balls rolled in walnuts and paprika, with crackers
s.how: Mix 200g grated cheddar, 250g cream cheese and snipped chives. Roll into small balls and coat in finely chopped walnuts mixed with smoked paprika. Chill for an hour until firm. Serve with water crackers and stay inside the sphere.

m.note: Chili cumin flathead tacos with pineapple salsa, lime crema and cabbage
m.how: Dust 600g flathead in chilli, cumin and salt and pan-fry until just cooked. Dice half a pineapple with a little red onion and lime for salsa. Mix sour cream with lime for a crema. Fill corn tortillas with cabbage, fish, salsa and crema.

w.note: Dark chocolate mousse topped with crushed cookies
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate and cool slightly. Whip 300ml cream and whisk 3 egg whites to soft peaks. Stir the yolks into the chocolate, then fold in cream and whites. Spoon into glasses, chill, top with crushed chocolate biscuits and a speckled chocolate egg.

d.note: Slushy frozen lemonade blended with ice, served in big cups
d.how: Squeeze 6 lemons and dissolve 150g sugar in the juice with 500ml water. Freeze in a tray for 2 hours. Blitz with a few handfuls of ice until slushy and pour into big cups with straws. Perfect for a long queue in the heat.
